description.en: Pornhub-style parody reskin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: charcoal-black + orange pill-button theme (follows system light/dark), rounded Baloo-2 'Deephub' wordmark, 18+ entry gag, HD badges, and a 'today's hot pick' sidebar card. 纯整活主题,不含任何露骨内容。

VS Code (from a code-server release) inside DSH: a right-sidebar tab driven by the plugin's own launcher over the in-process VS Code server (lib/launcher.mjs), plus an editor bridge (assets/extensions/dshcs-editor-bridge) that gives the agent what only the editor knows (unsaved buffers, language-server diagnostics, the active selection) and lets editor gestures drive the session. The bridge is completely read-only: all four of its routes (/health, /sync, /old, /event) are reads. Asking DSH from the editor opens a floating dialog inside the DSH page (draggable, resizable, bottom-right): the plugin's client half sends the question as user input (POST /api/code-server/ask/send) and renders that session's new content with DSH's own Markdown renderer - the same @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives instance the UI uses, required from the page's module table, so typography, highlighting and math match the interface and a renderer version mismatch is impossible. Thinking appears as collapsed rows and approval requests (writing outside the workspace / running commands) can be answered in place: whole-plugin write route POST /api/code-server/ask/approve, constrained to pending in-process requests and the outcomes allowed-once/rejected; dialog-first for 5 minutes, handed back to the official card the moment the dialog closes, never auto-approved. There is no build step anywhere: lib/client.js (client half including the dialog panel) and the extension are committed hand-written source, devDependencies holds a single test-only entry, and the published package carries no frontend bundle. Also: the tab claims DSH file addresses (dsh-resource://file/**) by file type (setting claimExtensions), so produced-file chips, delivered-file previews and inline prose mentions open in the workbench; the IDE is a resident surface moved with Element.moveBefore instead of being remounted, so switching sidebar tabs does not reload it; opening the tab switches the right sidebar to fullscreen by default (setting fullscreenOnOpen); a workspace switch re-navigates the workbench with the new ?folder= without restarting the IDE process. Requires a DSH with the right-sidebar services (sidebarRightTabs/sidebarRight, >= 0.1.5-alpha.1); older DSH versions only get an upgrade notice on the settings page. Two serving modes: loopback port (default) or same-origin mount on DSH's own webServer (/code-server, protected by ctx.connection.requestRejection). The diff the bridge opens always has the real pre-write text on the left, taken from result.value.before in tools/post-execute into a bounded snapshot cache and fetched by opaque key over the read-only GET /old, so files that are not open in the editor work too. No code-server Node layer, no argon2, no C++ toolchain.
